strength / equipment: About 2,800 cavalrymen in two brigades, with one six-gun battery (S55, pp. 17, 19)

notes: With Pender's division following, nearly 14,000 men of Hill's corps on the pike that morning (S55, p. 19).

commander: Maj. Gen. Abner Doubleday (after Reynolds fell)
